notes.title: 0.1.2 Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We've just updated the game's demo version.[/p][p][/p][h3]Update Details[/h3][p][b] UI and Effects Improvements[/b]: The UI has been refined for a cleaner and more polished look.[/p][p][b]New Monsters and Allies Added[/b]: New monsters and allies have been introduced, enhancing strategic gameplay.[/p][p][b]Steam Cloud Enhancements[/b]: Improved the save system for a smoother experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Data Compatibility Notice[/h3][p]Due to changes in the game's data structure from this update, previous save files might no longer be compatible.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.[/p][p]If you encounter issues or wish to unlock all progress immediately, please follow the instructions below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Windows[/b]:
C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\userdata\\{SteamID}\\3265720\\remote[/p][p][b]Mac[/b]:
~/Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/{SteamID}/3265720/remote[/p][p]Replace the [b]'playerData.json'[/b] file located at the above paths with the JSON file provided in the following link. This will grant you access to all missions and upgrade resources.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GQY1U_18Oly8ai2JDZ2fJhGDGis7orCn/view?usp=drive_link"]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GQY1U_18Oly8ai2JDZ2fJhGDGis7orCn/view?usp=drive_link[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]If you have feedback or want to discuss the game further, please join us on our Discord channel![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/RqsZeySAkW"]https://discord.gg/RqsZeySAkW[/url][/p]

notes.title: 2025 2Q Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello, Soulers!
This is Rabbit, the director of Soulers.

It has already been two months since we released the demo.
During this time, we have been working hard to make the game even more enjoyable, and based on that, we have planned several improvements.

[b]📌 Q2 2025 Roadmap[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786502/b5a67952718b792afe213edd1d91d2489c26124f.png[/img]

For this update, we will focus on both [b]overall game improvements[/b] and[b] new content additions.[/b]

[b]🔹 Game system and balance improvements
🔹 New monsters and bosses
🔹 Additional companion characters
🔹 Expansion of new maps and exploration elements[/b]

Additionally, we plan to conduct a [b]Steam Playtest in June[/b] (available in Korean and English), so we would love to have your interest and participation!

We truly appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm. Thank you!

notes.title: Improving the Gameplay Experience
notes.content:
Hello, this is Drabit Studio.

We'd like to thank everyone who played our demo and gave us valuable feedback and comments. Your support has allowed us to take another step forward in our quest to make a better game.

This year, we're working on a number of things to polish the game and bring you more content. In particular, we're overhauling the game to improve missions, gameplay, and storyline across the board.

We'll be updating the demo as soon as we're done with the reorganization, so stay tuned.
Additionally, your wishlists and reviews are a huge help to the development team. Your participation and feedback is our most valuable asset.

We'll continue to do our best to bring you great games, thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786502/425ffb503e94ef39c5831da1ae26fcdc0fa40acc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Soulers Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Drabit Studio!

We're thrilled to announce that the 'Soulers-Demo' is now available on Steam!

After two and a half years of development, we’re excited to share this demo with you.

We've implemented valuable feedback from various game shows and added new elements that can enhance our gameplay experience. We hope you enjoy playing the demo as much as we enjoyed creating it!

There's still a lot to improve, and we’re planning to improving it through updates. Your continued interest and feedback will be invaluable as we refine the game further.

Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786502/7c86863f6d95dc77c3ce2c65cea4030667b3242f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, this is Drabit Studio.
On December 27, 2024, we will finally release the [b]"Soulers-Demo" on Steam[/b]!

In this demo, you’ll experience approximately 40 minutes of gameplay and get a taste of the core mechanics of the game.

[h2]Supported Languages[/h2]
The demo supports Korean, English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

[h2]Key Features of the Demo[/h2]

[h3]4 Stages and Powerful Bosses[/h3]
Explore 4 unique stages filled with challenging enemies.
At the end of each stage, face off against powerful bosses that require strategy and skill to defeat!

[h3]3 Weapons and 7 Crew Members[/h3]
Discover 3 different weapon types and 7 unique crew members, each with their own abilities.
Combine weapons and crew members to create your own strategies and unlock limitless synergies!

[h3]Upgrade System[/h3]
Clear stages and collect resources to enhance the main character, "Makina."
Choose from 9 unique traits to tailor your gameplay style!

We sincerely thank you for your continued support and encouragement.
We look forward to your participation and hope you enjoy the demo!

Thank you!

notes.title: Hello, world!
notes.content:
Hello, we're [b]Dravit Studio[/b], the developers of Soulers.

<Soulers> is a shooter game that slows down time and allows you to mix and match different companions to fight alongside you.

We'll be releasing a demo sometime this year, and we're looking forward to connecting with you through the Steam Community, Discord, and Twitter.

We look forward to your support and love.
Thank you!
